title: 港股开盘下行、恒科未显修复，致丰复牌近乎平盘；油价回落但长债仍高

关键资产图

A股市场
休市至10月7日
A股9月30日中位数
-0.09%

-0.46%

+0.50%

关键词云图

A股休市油价回落复牌微升军工领涨铜链走强通信设备太空+5.16%百威拨备停牌风险算力传闻新型电池期指上行
利好利空中性
重大新闻汇总
国际
油价由早间上涨转为回落，供应风险溢价仍高
Reuters 09:22 CST附近显示布伦特约102.20美元；Yahoo Finance 09:50 CST显示WTI约90.25美元、跌0.94%。方向反转削弱油气追涨理由并缓和下游成本压力，但绝对价位和地缘风险仍高。
政策
七部门发布新型电池“十五五”规划
工信系统原始政策信息显示，到2030年全固态电池初步规模化应用、长寿命锂电循环寿命达到1.5万次，并拓展储能、智能终端、机器人等场景；受益必须以订单与价格确认，不能把规划目标当作已实现业绩。
政策
福建以法定决定推动科技创新与产业创新融合
福建省政府10月1日发布省人大常委会决定，提出聚焦新能源、新材料、基础软件、工业软件和人工智能，并推动研发投入强度到2030年提高至2.7%以上；区域平台、成果转化和先进制造获得中期政策线索。
产业
腾讯据报拟向Oracle租用约10万枚先进芯片
Reuters转述《金融时报》称潜在五年合同约70亿美元、约30%预付；Reuters未能独立核实，腾讯与Oracle未置评。算力供给是正向线索，但高额资本承诺与消息未确认构成反证，腾讯不据此升级为多头卡。
美股
军工、铜、通信与太空领涨，IT服务和广告居后
10月2日Moomoo快照显示航空航天与国防+3.90%、铜+3.73%、通信设备+3.33%，太空概念+5.16%；IT服务-2.72%、广告代理-3.30%。ELMT、TGB、SILC和PL分别涨8.75%、7.70%、11.93%和8.43%，A/H映射须等港股开盘与A股10月8日复市验证。
产业
中国暂停10月对港澳以外成品油出口，亚洲炼油利润率走高
Reuters称10月成品油出口配额执行暂停，亚洲汽油裂解价差升至每桶50美元以上纪录区间；炼化供给偏紧利好区域炼油利润，但高油价也加重运输和制造成本。
公司
致丰工业电子复牌仅微升，收购意向尚未获强价格确认
港交所10月2日公告显示双方签订非约束性备忘录并给予两个月独家期；Yahoo Finance延迟报价显示09:20报2.07港元、较前收仅涨0.49%，成交量暂不可得。尚无正式协议、作价或强价格反馈。
公司
百威亚太披露税项费用与应收账款拨备，开盘继续偏弱
港交所10月4日公告称内部重组将产生约5200万美元非基础性预提税费用及约3000万美元应收款拨备；Yahoo Finance延迟报价显示09:20报5.65港元、跌0.44%，未出现负面信息后的反转确认。
公司
中华银科技延迟业绩并继续停牌
港交所10月2日公告显示2025/26中期及全年业绩继续延迟，股份自2025年10月2日起停牌且仍待满足复牌指引；现金短缺、审核不确定性和不可交易状态构成明确回避理由。
宏观
香港8月零售销售延续复苏，但汽车品类下滑
香港政府数据经Reuters核验显示，8月零售额同比增5.6%至321亿港元、连续第16个月增长，首八个月增8.5%；珠宝钟表增11.9%，汽车及零部件跌22%，消费复苏仍明显分化。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
纳指期货走强，WTI转跌，但长债仍在高位
Yahoo Finance 09:50 CST延迟行情显示道指期货+0.08%、标普500期货+0.19%、纳指100期货+0.50%，10年期美债收益率约5.28%；WTI约跌0.94%至90.25美元。油价方向反转是实质增量，长债高位仍限制成长估值。
板块对照
期指强化成长方向，但代表股仍缺同一时点确认
15只排行代表股的可靠同一时点夜盘报价仍不可得，不能把10月2日涨跌默认延续。纳指期货强于道指提供宏观支持，5.28%长债构成反证。
A/H映射
港股开盘下行且恒科未跑赢，科技修复尚未确认
恒指09:35约跌0.46%，恒科09:47约跌0.43%；开盘时智谱和联想走强，但小米、网易、京东等偏弱。A股休市使军工、铜、通信、充电桩与激光雷达映射仍待10月8日验证；油价回落降低上游追涨优先级。

盘前结论

A股国庆休市至10月7日；港股已开市，南向互联互通仍受内地假期安排影响。AKShare文件仅覆盖9月30日A股与10月2日港股旧时段；最新云端行情显示恒指09:35约跌0.46%、恒科09:47约跌0.43%。

纳指100期货约涨0.50%，WTI转跌约0.94%，边际缓和科技与下游成本压力。但恒科未跑赢、10年期美债约5.28%，致丰复牌仅微升，百威亚太仍弱，风险偏好没有全面确认。

基准判断调整为“港股弱势分化、科技修复未确认”：不再强调油气追涨，事件驱动只保留条件关注；A股映射只列10月8日复市观察。08:44后未发现改变判断的新政策或重大交易所公告。

重点个股关注

致丰工业电子
HK.01710
条件关注
立讯精密旗下买方拟收购75%股权；09:20延迟报价2.07港元、较2.06港元前收仅涨0.49%，成交量暂不可得，强价格确认尚未出现。
确认条件：正式协议披露作价与资金安排，复牌后成交活跃且价格守住停牌前收盘，并相对港股电子制造板块取得正超额。
风险与失效：交易可能不进行，强制要约条款、审批、融资或复牌后冲高回落均使关注失效；不把意向书当作已完成收购。
百威亚太
HK.01876
回避
10月4日公告新增约5200万美元非基础性税项费用及约3000万美元应收款拨备；09:20延迟报价5.65港元、跌0.44%，仍未反转。
解除条件：开盘后重新站上5.68港元并放量强于必需消费板块，同时公司说明回款进度与一次性费用边界。
风险与失效：政府客户回款、盈利质量与消费复苏持续性仍有不确定性；若继续放量下跌，维持回避。
中华银科技
HK.00515
回避
中期及全年业绩继续延迟，股份自2025年10月2日起停牌，当前没有可交易报价；公司披露现金短缺并继续推进融资与审核。
解除条件：刊发完整经审计财务资料、满足复牌指引并恢复有序交易。
风险与失效：审计、持续经营、融资与流动性风险均未解决，任何未经核验的复牌或融资传闻不构成转多依据。

板块轮动看板

油气/炼化上游WTI由涨转跌削弱追涨依据；布伦特仍高，转为观察而非优先多头。
港股电子并购致丰复牌仅微升，仍需正式条款、成交量和相对强度。
军工/铜/通信/太空隔夜美股广度偏强，但A股休市、港股缺少同主题公司级价格确认，暂作方向观察。
IT服务/广告/长久期科技隔夜行业垫底且长债收益率约5.26%，高估值修复仍受压。

逻辑链

供应风险仍高但WTI由涨转跌 → 油气上游追涨依据减弱 → 下游成本压力边际缓和。
美股军工、铜、通信与太空领涨 → A/H主题方向改善 → 港股开盘与A股10月8日复市才是本地验证。
纳指期货约涨0.50%但10年债约5.28% → 成长方向与估值约束并存 → 恒科偏弱使本地修复尚未确认。
公司级公告优先 → 01710复牌仅微升、仍待正式条款和成交确认，01876与00515继续回避。

风险雷达

油价与地缘升级WTI虽回落，但Brent仍在约102美元；供应冲击再起会迅速恢复通胀、运输成本与成长估值压力。
复牌与小盘流动性01710的非约束意向可能不落地，复牌后跳空和回撤风险均高。
快照时效AKShare文件为9月30日/10月2日旧时段；15只排行代表股运行时夜盘报价不可得，均已降级而未外推。

数据来源与时间点

数据来源与截止：首轮政策、港交所公告与行业证据沿用08:44 CST已核验证据；09:15增量通过财联社、金十、中国政府网及港交所预先界定文件页定向复核，未发现08:44后改变结论的新政策或重大公告。Yahoo Finance与华盛通延迟行情：恒指09:35约-0.46%，恒科09:47约-0.43%，01710与01876在09:20分别约+0.49%与-0.44%；09:50 CST道指/标普500/纳指100期货约+0.08%/+0.19%/+0.50%，10年期美债约5.28%，WTI约-0.94%。Reuters 09:22 CST附近显示布伦特约102.20美元。AKShare与美股排行未更新，继续按旧时段证据标注。复核时间：2026-10-05 09:54 CST。

Keyword Cloud

A shares closedOil easesFlat resumptionDefense leadsCopper strengthCommunicationsSpace +5.16%Bud provisionsSuspension riskCompute reportAdvanced batteryFutures firm
PositiveNegativeNeutral
Major News
Global
Oil reverses an early gain while the supply-risk premium stays elevated
Reuters around 09:22 CST put Brent near $102.20, while Yahoo Finance at 09:50 CST showed WTI near $90.25, down 0.94%. The reversal reduces the case for chasing upstream oil and eases downstream costs, but absolute prices and geopolitical risk remain high.
Policy
Seven agencies release the 15th Five-Year Plan for advanced batteries
Primary industry-policy material targets initial mass adoption of all-solid-state batteries and 15,000-cycle long-life lithium batteries by 2030, with storage, smart devices and robotics among the use cases. Targets are not current earnings and require order and price confirmation.
Policy
Fujian formalizes deeper integration of technology and industrial innovation
The Fujian government published a provincial legislature decision on Oct 1 covering renewables, new materials, basic and industrial software, and AI, while targeting R&D intensity above 2.7% by 2030. It offers a medium-term policy signal for platforms, commercialization and advanced manufacturing.
Industry
Tencent reportedly considers leasing roughly 100,000 advanced chips from Oracle
Reuters cited the Financial Times on a possible five-year, roughly $7 billion contract with about 30% prepaid. Reuters could not independently verify it and neither company commented. Compute access is positive, but the unconfirmed report and large capital commitment prevent a bullish upgrade.
US moves
Defense, copper, communications and space lead; IT services and advertising lag
The Oct 2 Moomoo snapshot showed Aerospace & Defense +3.90%, Copper +3.73%, Communication Equipment +3.33% and Space +5.16%, while IT Services fell 2.72% and Advertising Agencies 3.30%. ELMT, TGB, SILC and PL rose 8.75%, 7.70%, 11.93% and 8.43%; A/H mapping still needs Hong Kong open and the Oct 8 A-share reopening.
Industry
China suspends October fuel-product exports beyond Hong Kong and Macao
Reuters reported that October export-quota execution was paused and Asian gasoline refining margins moved above $50 a barrel into record territory. Tighter regional supply can help refiners, but expensive fuel raises transport and manufacturing costs.
Company
Trio resumes only slightly higher, leaving the approach without strong price confirmation
The Oct 2 HKEX filing records a non-binding MOU. A delayed Yahoo Finance quote showed HK$2.07 at 09:20, only 0.49% above the prior close, with volume unavailable. There is no definitive agreement, price or strong market confirmation.
Company
Budweiser APAC flags tax and receivables charges and stays weak after the open
The Oct 4 HKEX filing adds about $52 million of non-underlying tax expense and a $30 million receivables provision. A delayed Yahoo Finance quote showed HK$5.65 at 09:20, down 0.44%, with no reversal confirmation.
Company
China Silver Technology delays results and remains suspended
Its Oct 2 HKEX filing says FY2025/26 interim and annual results remain delayed. The shares have been suspended since Oct 2, 2025 and still need to satisfy resumption guidance. Cash strain, audit uncertainty and illiquidity support an Avoid status.
Macro
Hong Kong August retail sales extend recovery, while autos contract
Hong Kong government data verified by Reuters showed August retail sales up 5.6% year on year to HK$32.1 billion, the 16th straight increase, and the first eight months up 8.5%. Jewellery and watches rose 11.9%, while motor vehicles and parts fell 22%, underscoring an uneven recovery.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Futures
Nasdaq futures firm and WTI turns lower, but long yields remain elevated
Delayed Yahoo Finance quotes at 09:50 CST showed Dow futures +0.08%, S&P 500 futures +0.19% and Nasdaq-100 futures +0.50%, with the U.S. 10-year near 5.28%. WTI was 0.94% lower at $90.25. The oil reversal is material, while the high yield still restrains growth.
Cross-check
Futures support growth directionally, but representative stocks still lack confirmation
Reliable same-time overnight quotes remain unavailable for all 15 ranking representatives, so Oct 2 moves are not assumed to persist. Nasdaq futures outperforming Dow offers macro support, while a 5.28% yield is counter-evidence.
A/H mapping
Hong Kong opens lower and technology does not outperform
The Hang Seng was about 0.46% lower at 09:35 and Hang Seng Tech about 0.43% lower at 09:47. Zhipu and Lenovo were firmer at the open, while Xiaomi, NetEase and JD were weak. A-share mappings await Oct 8; softer oil lowers upstream-chase priority.

Pre-open View

Mainland A shares are closed through Oct 7; Hong Kong is trading.The AKShare file is prior-session evidence. Fresh quotes show the Hang Seng about 0.46% lower at 09:35 and Hang Seng Tech about 0.43% lower at 09:47.

Nasdaq-100 futures were about 0.50% higher and WTI about 0.94% lower, marginally easing technology and downstream cost pressure.But Hang Seng Tech did not outperform, the U.S. 10-year was near 5.28%, Trio resumed only slightly higher and Budweiser remained weak.

The base case shifts to weak Hong Kong dispersion with no confirmed technology recovery. Upstream oil is no longer a priority chase; event-driven names remain conditional. A-share mappings await Oct 8. No post-08:44 policy or major exchange filing changed the view.

Stocks to Watch

Trio Industrial Electronics
HK.01710
Conditional Watch
A Luxshare-controlled buyer proposes acquiring 75% under a non-binding MOU. A delayed 09:20 quote showed HK$2.07, only 0.49% above the prior close, with volume unavailable; strong price confirmation has not appeared.
Confirmation: a definitive agreement discloses price and funding, and active resumed trading holds above the pre-suspension close with positive excess return versus Hong Kong electronics manufacturers.
Risk/invalidation: the deal may not proceed; mandatory-offer terms, approvals, financing or a failed reopening rally invalidate the watch. The MOU is not treated as a completed acquisition.
Budweiser APAC
HK.01876
Avoid
The Oct 4 filing adds roughly $52 million of non-underlying tax expense and a $30 million receivables provision. A delayed 09:20 quote showed HK$5.65, down 0.44%, with no reversal confirmation.
Removal condition: it reclaims HK$5.68 on volume, outperforms consumer staples, and management clarifies collections and the one-off scope.
Risk/invalidation: government-customer collections, earnings quality and the durability of consumption recovery remain uncertain; further volume-led weakness keeps the Avoid status.
China Silver Technology
HK.00515
Avoid
Interim and annual results remain delayed and the shares have been suspended since Oct 2, 2025, leaving no tradable quote. The company reports cash strain while pursuing financing and audit work.
Removal condition: complete audited financials are published, resumption guidance is satisfied, and orderly trading resumes.
Risk/invalidation: audit, going-concern, financing and liquidity risks remain unresolved; unverified resumption or funding rumours do not justify an upgrade.

Sector Rotation Board

Upstream oil/refiningWTI turning lower weakens the chase case; elevated Brent keeps the group on watch.
Hong Kong electronics dealTrio resumed only slightly higher; terms, volume and relative strength are still required.
Defense/copper/comms/spaceU.S. breadth was firm, but A shares are closed and Hong Kong lacks same-theme company-level price confirmation.
IT services/advertising/long durationThese U.S. industries lagged and a roughly 5.26% yield continues to restrain expensive growth.

Logic Chain

Supply risk stays high but WTI reverses lower → less reason to chase upstream oil → downstream cost pressure eases marginally.
U.S. defense, copper, communications and space lead → better A/H thematic direction → Hong Kong open and the Oct 8 A-share reopening provide local confirmation.
Nasdaq futures near +0.50% but the 10-year near 5.28% → growth direction and valuation restraint coexist → weak Hang Seng Tech leaves local recovery unconfirmed.
Company filings take priority → HK.01710 resumes only slightly higher and still awaits terms and volume; HK.01876 and HK.00515 remain Avoid.

Risk Radar

Oil and geopolitical escalationWTI has eased, but Brent remains near $102; renewed disruption would quickly revive inflation, transport-cost and valuation pressure.
Resumption and small-cap liquidityHK.01710’s non-binding approach may not complete, and both a gap and a failed reopening rally are material risks.
Snapshot freshnessThe AKShare file is from Sep 30/Oct 2; runtime overnight quotes for all 15 ranking representatives were unavailable and were not extrapolated.

Sources and Timestamps

Sources and cutoff: first-run policy and HKEX evidence remains the verified 08:44 CST baseline. The 09:15 review checked CLS, Jin10, the State Council policy index and HKEX predefined documents and found no post-08:44 item that changed the view. Delayed Yahoo Finance and HSTong quotes: Hang Seng -0.46% at 09:35, Hang Seng Tech -0.43% at 09:47, HK.01710 +0.49% and HK.01876 -0.44% at 09:20; Dow/S&P 500/Nasdaq-100 futures +0.08%/+0.19%/+0.50%, the U.S. 10-year near 5.28% and WTI -0.94% at 09:50. Reuters around 09:22 put Brent near $102.20. AKShare and U.S. rankings were unchanged and remain prior-session evidence. Reviewed: 2026-10-05 09:54 CST.
